node.label: non-Zellweger spectrum disorder
node.definition: A peroxisome biogenesis disorder which is due to defect in PEX7 or PEX5. This includes rhizomelic chondrodysplasia punctata due to defect in PEX7 or PEX5, and adult Refsum Disease due to defects in PEX7.

children_labels.MONDO:0100265: peroxisome biogenesis disorder due to PEX5 defect in the PEX7-binding domain
children_labels.MONDO:0100272: peroxisome biogenesis disorder due to PEX7 defect

mechanism_classes.label: peroxisomal biogenesis / peroxisomal enzyme or transporter defect
